sentences: At power-on the terminal checks its stored profile.
If the profile is missing, the terminal creates a new random session value and starts a session.
If the profile is valid, the terminal reuses the stored session value.
The terminal logs every session event in a local file.
The log file is rotated daily.
Rotation was introduced after customer feedback.

requirements.text: At power-on, the terminal shall check its stored profile.
If the profile is missing, the terminal shall create a new random session value.
If the profile is missing, the terminal shall start a session.
If the profile is valid, the terminal shall reuse the stored session value.
The terminal shall log every session event in a local file.
The terminal shall rotate the log file daily.
